name: Creative Agents Benchmark
description: A benchmark for evaluating embodied agents performing open-ended creative tasks in the open-world game Minecraft, focusing on the agents' ability to create diverse buildings from free-form language instructions.
reputation: A recent benchmark for open-ended creative embodied agents in Minecraft that is still early-stage and not yet widely adopted as a standard community benchmark.
notes: Uses GPT-4V for novel evaluation metrics; benchmark and models are open-source.
